metadata.title: Email Core Pattern
metadata.remarks: Defines the core architectural capability for institutional email services. This pattern represents stable architectural intent focused on mailbox-based email communication. Detailed usage constraints and enforcement rules are defined in platform configurations and operational standards, not in this pattern.

components.title: Institutional Email Service
components.description: Provides institutional email transport, mailbox services, and message delivery for academic, administrative, and institutional correspondence.

links.text: Supports Communications Management (BC220) business capability in the Business Reference Model (BRM).
Maps to Email (TC048) in the Technology Reference Model (TRM).
Handles Communications and Correspondence (DE188) data entity in the Data Reference Model (DRM).

implemented-requirements.remarks: Institutional email services must integrate with enterprise identity systems to ensure authentication and proper attribution of email activity.
Email communications must be protected during transmission to preserve confidentiality and integrity.
Email systems must generate audit records sufficient to support accountability, investigation, and incident response.

components.remarks: This pattern establishes baseline mailbox-based email semantics and core security expectations. It intentionally excludes notification gateways, collaboration relays, and bulk messaging behavior, which are defined in separate architectural patterns.
